info.title: CF Meet Platform Access internal API
info.description: Internal HTTP surface of services/platform-access, the shared identity authority (Part IV Workstream B, ADR 0032): GET /health and /ready (public, no data) and the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API. Every /internal/v1 path — including unknown ones — requires a valid service token (cfmeet.platform.internal-http) and the operation's permission from Platform Access's trust bundle; a customer credential is never accepted in its place. Request bodies are limited to 64 KiB. Messages are defined by cfmeet.platform-access.identity. Consumers: Calling (authenticate, resolve / register principals, read identity and the change feed), Meeting Service (first-party principal ensure, Part V H §104), Messaging (authenticate, resolve, read identity), Numbering (authenticate, resolve, read identity), the operator console (administration).

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer <service token> (cfmeet.platform.internal-http). Permissions come only from Platform Access's trust bundle.

platform-access.identity.v1.ApplicationS.description: A scope an application may grant to its credentials.

platform-access.identity.v1.AuthFailureR.description: Why a presented credential does not authenticate. For the consumer's logs and metrics only: every rejection is shown to the customer as the same normalized authentication failure.

platform-access.identity.v1.Authenticate.description: POST /internal/v1/credentials/authenticate (permission platform-credential.authenticate). The presented bearer value; never logged, never stored.

platform-access.identity.v1.AuthorityCha.description: The trusted authority of an authenticated credential: every link, the effective scopes (sorted) and the authorized-principal restriction. The tenant of a request is ALWAYS taken from here, never from a request.

platform-access.identity.v1.AuthorityMod.description: FULL: every link ACTIVE, the scopes decide. SAFETY_ONLY: the tenant, application or environment is SUSPENDED — the consumer allows only its safety operations (e.g. end a live call).

platform-access.identity.v1.ChangePage.description: A page of the identity change feed. Persist nextAfter only after applying the page.

platform-access.identity.v1.ChangesReque.description: POST /internal/v1/identity/changes: the page after the cursor (permission platform-identity.read).

platform-access.identity.v1.CredentialEf.description: Derived from the persisted lifecycle fields at evaluation time. Only ACTIVE and ROTATION_OVERLAP authenticate.

platform-access.identity.v1.CredentialSc.description: A scope granted to a credential.

platform-access.identity.v1.CredentialSn.description: An API credential WITHOUT any secret or verifier material (lastFour is for masked display only).

platform-access.identity.v1.CredentialSt.description: GET /internal/v1/credentials/{credentialId}: status, expiry and revocation of a credential of the delegated scope.

platform-access.identity.v1.EnsurePrinci.description: POST /internal/v1/principals/ensure (Part V H §104): the first-party login authority maps an account it authenticated itself to its communication principal in its signed FIRST_PARTY delegated scope. Idempotent per (environment, kind, externalReference). The reference is the login authority's opaque account id (or, for BOT_OR_SERVICE, the opaque id of the application's own non-human participant such as a meeting chat's system owner), never an email or telephone number.
The ensured ACTIVE principal and whether this call created it.

platform-access.identity.v1.EntityKind.description: Kind of identity entity a change describes.

platform-access.identity.v1.EnvironmentS.description: An application environment. Live telecom effects are possible only in PRODUCTION and only when allowed.

platform-access.identity.v1.Error.description: The error envelope (never echoes a presented credential, a verifier or row content).

platform-access.identity.v1.ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes of the Platform Access envelope.

platform-access.identity.v1.EvaluateRequ.description: POST /internal/v1/authorization/evaluate: may the credential of the delegated scope perform an operation needing requiredScopes (optionally for principalId), NOW?

platform-access.identity.v1.GrantBasis.description: How an application scope was granted.

platform-access.identity.v1.IdentityChan.description: One committed identity change. Sequences are monotonic in commit order; applying a snapshot is idempotent (revision-guarded). Snapshots never carry verifier material.

platform-access.identity.v1.ImportReceip.description: GET /internal/v1/identity/imports/{bundleDigest}: Platform Access's receipt of an operator-imported Part III identity bundle (digests and counts only).

platform-access.identity.v1.PrincipalRef.description: A principal reference: either principalId, or kind + externalReference.

platform-access.identity.v1.PrincipalSna.description: A communication principal: an opaque reference only — never a phone number or contact value (TELEPHONE_ENDPOINT principals carry a ContactReference id).

platform-access.identity.v1.PublicId.description: Non-secret lookup id of a credential (24 lower-case hex).

platform-access.identity.v1.ResolveReque.description: POST /internal/v1/principals/resolve: resolve references inside the delegated scope only.

platform-access.identity.v1.Revision.description: Entity revision: 1 at insert, +1 on every effective update. Consumers apply a snapshot only when its revision is newer than the one they hold.

platform-access.identity.v1.ScopeName.description: A scope registered by Platform Access (GET /internal/v1/scopes), e.g. calls.read, numbers.search, numbers.admin, sms.send.

platform-access.identity.v1.ScopeTrust.description: STANDARD: grantable to any tenant. FIRST_PARTY_ONLY: FIRST_PARTY tenants only. PRIVILEGED_OPERATOR: an explicit audited operator grant to a FIRST_PARTY application (numbers.admin); never an ordinary grant.

platform-access.identity.v1.ServiceAccou.description: A machine identity of an environment.

platform-access.identity.v1.SuspendedLin.description: The suspended link behind a SAFETY_ONLY authority.

platform-access.identity.v1.TelephoneEnd.description: POST /internal/v1/principals/telephone-endpoints: the TELEPHONE_ENDPOINT principal of a protected public party — referenced by its opaque ContactReference, never a number. Idempotent.

platform-access.identity.v1.TenantClassi.description: FIRST_PARTY (CosmicForge-operated) or EXTERNAL; decided by Platform Access only, never by a request.

platform-access.identity.v1.Throttle.description: Failed-authentication throttling: the consumer answers 429 with Retry-After instead of 401; thresholdCrossed is true exactly once per window (one deduplicated guessing incident). A correct secret is never throttled.

platform-access.identity.v1.TombstoneReq.description: POST /internal/v1/principals/{principalId}/tombstone: the human operator who decided the tombstone (audited as the actor).

platform-access.identity.v1.TombstoneRes.description: The tombstoned principal: DEACTIVATED for ever, non-identifying reference.

platform-access.identity.v1.TrustedConte.description: GET /internal/v1/identity/context: the caller's signed delegated scope re-validated against the authority (a forged or stale tenant / application claim is DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID).

platform.common.v1.CorrelationId.description: Server-generated identifier that stays stable across every hop of one causal operation.

platform.common.v1.PrincipalKind.description: Category of communication principal (Part B section 10).

platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.

get.description: Readiness: database reachable and no migration pending (counts and versions only).

post.description: Validate a presented customer credential and return its trusted authority chain (or the rejection reason and any throttle). The presented value is never logged or stored. Permission: `platform-credential.authenticate`.

get.description: Status, expiry and revocation of a credential of the delegated scope (no secret, no verifier). Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

post.description: Re-evaluate NOW whether the credential of the delegated scope may perform an operation needing the given scopes (optionally for a principal). Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

get.description: The trusted context of the caller's delegated scope: tenant, application, environment, service account and authority mode. Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

post.description: A page of the identity change feed after the cursor (consumer projections). POST because internal requests carry no query strings. Permission: `platform-identity.read`.

get.description: Receipt of an operator-imported identity bundle (hand-off verification by the previous authority). Permission: `platform-identity.read`.
The server-authoritative scope registry (Calling, Numbering and SMS scopes; trust levels). Permission: `platform-identity.read`.

post.description: Resolve principal references inside the delegated scope only. Permission: `platform-principal.resolve`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

Get or create the TELEPHONE_ENDPOINT principal of a protected public party (by ContactReference, never a number). Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.register`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

Part V H §104: get or create the NATIVE_CF_USER / TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PARTICIPANT principal of an account the first-party login authority (Meeting Service) authenticated itself. Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.ensure`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token; it must be a FIRST_PARTY tenant at FULL authority (EXTERNAL → POLICY_VIOLATION, suspended chain or principal → INVALID_STATE).
Tombstone a principal for good (audited with the named human operator). Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.register`.

Create a tenant. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

get.description: Read a tenant. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

post.description: Suspend / reactivate a tenant. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Create an application. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

get.description: Read an application. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

post.description: Suspend / reactivate an application. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Create an environment. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Allow a scope for an application (privileged scopes need `privileged: true` and a FIRST_PARTY tenant). Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

get.description: List the application's allowed scopes. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

delete.description: Withdraw a scope from the application and its credentials. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

post.description: Suspend / reactivate an environment. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Allow / forbid live telecom (PRODUCTION only). Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Create a service account. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Register a principal (opaque reference). Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

get.description: List principals. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

post.description: Suspend / reactivate / revoke a service account. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Issue a credential; the raw credential is in the response exactly once. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

get.description: List credentials (masked). Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Read a credential (masked). Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

post.description: Rotate; the successor's raw credential is in the response exactly once. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Revoke immediately (idempotent). Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

put.description: Restrict a credential to act only for given principals. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

post.description: Suspend / reactivate / deactivate a principal. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.

Tombstone a principal. Operator administration: permission `platform-identity.administer` (operator console only); every mutation names its human operator (`X-CF-Operator`) and writes one append-only audit row.
